what: CNH Industrial makes agricultural and construction machinery under the Case IH, New Holland and Case brands: tractors, combine harvesters, excavators and loaders, plus a finance arm that lends to buyers.
customers: Farmers, agricultural contractors and construction companies worldwide, mostly through dealers.
money: tractors, combines, planters and precision farming technology
equipment financing for buyers and dealers
moat: Dealer networks and brands farmers have used for generations, with precision farming technology that keeps the machines connected to its software.
risks: Farm equipment demand has fallen sharply with crop prices
Revenue fell about 9% last year and about 8% a year over three years
Dealer inventories had to be reduced, which cut production further
opportunities: Analysts see about 38% upside from current levels
Dealer inventories are now much closer to normal, which should let production recover
Precision farming technology raises content and recurring revenue per machine
watch: Dealer inventory levels and agricultural equipment order rates.
